question: Which publication does the Human Protein Atlas ask you to cite for its subcellular data? Give the first author, the journal, the year and the PubMed id.

tool_uses.name: web_search
tool_uses.input: {"query":"\"Human Protein Atlas\" cite \"subcellular\" publication OR citing"}

turns.text:
According to the Human Protein Atlas citation guidelines, the publication requested to cite for subcellular data is:

* **Publication title:** *A subcellular map of the human proteome* (Source: [https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/licence](https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/licence) and [https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/publications](https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/publications))
* **First author:** PJ Thul (Peter J. Thul) (Source: [https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/licence](https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/licence) and [https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/publications](https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/publications))
* **Journal:** *Science* (Source: [https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/licence](https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/licence) and [https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/publications](https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/publications))
* **Year:** 2017 (Source: [https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/licence](https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/licence) and [https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/publications](https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/publications))
* **PubMed ID:** 28495876 (Source: [https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/licence](https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/licence) and [https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/publications](https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/publications))
